contract: construct() -> [p, d, k] describing p, p + d, ..., p + (k-1)d with 2 <= k <= 64, 1 <= d <= 5000 and last term at most 10^9. Every term must be prime (deterministic Miller-Rabin) and no prime may lie strictly between consecutive terms. Maximize k; the optimum below 10^9 is 6.
notes: Below 10^9 the longest such progressions have six terms (the first starts at 121174811), so the task recovers a six-term progression. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs; the Mahler measure and reciprocal sums are reported as floats. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.
